name: Mierzwa [MB]³ Systems
summary:
Mierzwa [MB]³ Systems is the immersive VR platform used in the Executive Attunement™ program. It targets the four domains that power distorts: Mind, Brain, Belief, and Behavior.

Through interactive perspective-switching, leaders retrain their perceptual systems to decode emotional, behavioral, and social signals with system-level precision—before misalignment takes hold.

Built for technically trained leaders navigating high-stakes environments.
